regional_summary_6h.headline: Armenian political and diplomatic tensions dominate the window, with Syria's fuel protests and Iran's diplomatic setbacks adding pressure
bullets: Armenia saw a concentrated surge of political instability including opposition figures warning of efforts to erase Armenian heritage in Karabakh and officials accusing Azerbaijan of desecrating a historic prince's tomb near Gandzasar.
Syrea experienced its largest protests since Assad's fall, driven by fuel price spikes, signaling severe civilian stress and potential governance pressure.
Iran's planned Oman-mediated talks with Gulf Arab states were postponed and the US blocked its nuclear chief from attending the Vienna conference, weakening diplomatic de-escalation channels.
regional_summary_6h.watch: Monitor Armenia-Azerbaijan diplomatic friction at Gandzasar and Karabakh heritage disputes for cross-border escalation signals.
